name: Log classification
summary: Assign each log line a severity class for routing and rollup.

input.state: The service name and time window followed by one log line.

severity.instructions: The severity this line represents for on-call purposes.

options.warning: Degraded behavior a human should see in a rollup.

cost.bound: one choice per line; batch through classify inputs

uncertainty.abstain: an unreadable line is 'notice' - a parse failure is not an outage
uncertainty.refusal: a refused line reports refused and counts toward the rollup as unclassified

limits: Severity here means paging policy, not log-level - an ERROR line can be 'noise' if it is expected churn.
Context is the supplied window only; the recipe does not read neighboring lines.

examples.api: POST /v1/systemone per item, or /v1/classify with items as inputs
examples.mcp: oak-mcp ask tool with the same envelope

evidence.label: unmeasured
evidence.note: Composition is verified over recorded answers by crates/gym/tests/recipes.rs; model-quality measurement runs through a gym suite and is pinned here only when it exists.
